raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Parked: not to merge until the enrollment work is finished and the owner says so. Marks the steps that stay out of automatic sharding once it is on by default, with the reason next to each.

## Claims

- No change to today's pipeline: a step without the flag already runs as it does.
- Every step with a fixed `parallelism` now says `automatic_shard: false`, which the default-on generator requires.

## Validation

The rendered pipeline at this head matches main's, with the same inputs, apart from the commit-specific pre-commit step. The list is to be regenerated on merge day.

## Details

- The list is what is known today: CPU steps (held until their owners agree), steps building mamba-ssm from source, steps whose command sets `PYTHONPATH=`, steps failing on main, and steps with their own open PRs. Open enrollment PRs will shrink it.
- Written by Claude Code. The human submitter has not yet reviewed every changed line.
